description: Proposed mixed cohort: reuse 40 existing single-vehicle clips whose prompts request motion; generate only 60 new clips, each requesting three moving vehicles. Actual motion, counts and mask quality require review.
class_schema_note: Use the existing label export schema; prompt multiplicity is not a change in semantic class IDs.
compatibility_note: Use jobs/datasets/create_walking_pov_mixed_100.sh for generation and --dataset-kind mixed for codec preparation. The original generator is unchanged and must not be used to resume this mixed dataset.

Realistic daylight, natural colors and perspective. One continuous shot.
